import type { Scenario } from '../types/demo'

export interface ScenarioOption {
  value: Scenario
  label: string
  group: 'Content' | 'Setup' | 'Saving' | 'Live changes' | 'Display'
  hint: string
}

export const scenarios: ScenarioOption[] = [
  { value: 'normal', label: 'Normal', group: 'Content', hint: 'All services respond normally.' },
  { value: 'empty', label: 'Empty dictionary', group: 'Content', hint: 'No active entries. Setup opens with an explanation; Start stays disabled.' },
  { value: 'zeroEligible', label: 'Zero eligible', group: 'Content', hint: 'No entries have definitions; setup preselects Front: Definition.' },
  { value: 'missingExample', label: 'Missing example', group: 'Content', hint: 'Front: Translation + Target-language example, dictionary order. Card 2 (caminar) merges its fallback.' },
  { value: 'archived', label: 'Archived dictionary', group: 'Content', hint: 'Cards is shown but cannot be started.' },
  { value: 'capabilityOff', label: 'Learning capability off', group: 'Content', hint: 'Cards is hidden from the Train menu.' },
  { value: 'backendOff', label: 'Backend unavailable', group: 'Setup', hint: 'Capability check fails; Train menu offers Retry.' },
  { value: 'prepareFailure', label: 'Prepare failure', group: 'Setup', hint: 'First prepare request returns service unavailable.' },
  { value: 'initialLoadFailure', label: 'First card load fails', group: 'Setup', hint: 'First card content request times out after Start.' },
  { value: 'preferenceConflict', label: 'Preference conflict', group: 'Setup', hint: 'Another device saved settings first; first save returns a version conflict.' },
  { value: 'savePending', label: 'Save pending (slow)', group: 'Saving', hint: 'Ratings take ~3.5s to be acknowledged.' },
  { value: 'saveFailed', label: 'Save failed', group: 'Saving', hint: 'First rating fails with a server error; retry succeeds.' },
  { value: 'saveLostResponse', label: 'Lost response, retry', group: 'Saving', hint: 'First rating is saved but its response is lost; retry returns the same attempt.' },
  { value: 'rateLimited', label: 'Rate limited', group: 'Saving', hint: 'First rating is rate limited with a 6s Retry-After.' },
  { value: 'idempotencyConflict', label: 'Reused operation conflict', group: 'Saving', hint: 'First rating reports its operation was already used differently.' },
  { value: 'undoPending', label: 'Undo pending (slow)', group: 'Saving', hint: 'Undo takes ~3.5s to be acknowledged.' },
  { value: 'undoConflict', label: 'Undo conflict', group: 'Saving', hint: 'A newer rating from another device blocks the first Undo.' },
  { value: 'contentChanged', label: 'Content changed', group: 'Live changes', hint: 'The first card is edited by the owner before you rate it.' },
  { value: 'entriesRemoved', label: 'Entries removed', group: 'Live changes', hint: 'Two queued entries are archived before their content loads.' },
  { value: 'accessRevoked', label: 'Access revoked', group: 'Live changes', hint: 'Access is removed after your first saved rating.' },
  { value: 'fullscreenRejected', label: 'Fullscreen rejected', group: 'Display', hint: 'Browser refuses fullscreen; practice uses a full-window overlay.' },
]

files.types/dictionary.ts:
import type { Direction } from './learning'

export type DictionaryKey = 'spanish' | 'arabic'

export interface Language {
  code: string
  name: string
  direction: Direction
}

export interface EntryRecord {
  entryId: string
  source: string
  translation: string
  transcription?: string
  definition?: string
  /** Example sentence written in the dictionary's source language. */
  sourceExample?: string
  /** Example sentence written in the dictionary's target language. */
  targetExample?: string
  /** Which language the author wrote the main example in (physical storage). */
  mainExample: 'source' | 'target'
  /** Author disabled the example; its text must never be exposed. */
  exampleDisabled?: boolean
  learningVersion: number
  archived?: boolean
}

export interface DictionaryRecord {
  key: DictionaryKey
  dictionaryId: string
  shareId: string
  title: string
  sourceLanguage: Language
  targetLanguage: Language
  visibility: 'private' | 'unlisted'
  archived: boolean
  entries: EntryRecord[]
}

import type { DictionaryKey } from './dictionary'

export type Role = 'owner' | 'reader' | 'anonymous'
export type LearnerId = 'A' | 'B'
export type Theme = 'light' | 'dark'

export type Scenario =
  | 'normal'
  | 'empty'
  | 'zeroEligible'
  | 'missingExample'
  | 'archived'
  | 'capabilityOff'
  | 'backendOff'
  | 'prepareFailure'
  | 'initialLoadFailure'
  | 'preferenceConflict'
  | 'savePending'
  | 'saveFailed'
  | 'saveLostResponse'
  | 'rateLimited'
  | 'idempotencyConflict'
  | 'undoPending'
  | 'undoConflict'
  | 'contentChanged'
  | 'entriesRemoved'
  | 'accessRevoked'
  | 'fullscreenRejected'

export interface DemoState {
  role: Role
  learner: LearnerId
  theme: Theme
  dictionaryKey: DictionaryKey
  scenario: Scenario
  shareKeyVersion: number
}

export type DisplayMode = 'fullscreen' | 'overlay' | 'dialog'
